baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic environmental portrait of one unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties working as an alpine seed-bank technician inside a bioluminescent mountain greenhouse at blue hour. Her facial appearance follows the attached reference, and she has a distinctly slender build: a long, narrow overall silhouette, a lightly built torso, lean arms and legs, slim upper arms and thighs, and clearly articulated wrists, elbows, waist, and knees. She is fully clothed in a fitted insulated teal coverall, thin thermal base layer, utility belt, nitrile-lined work gloves, and waterproof greenhouse boots. Show her entire body in a natural three-quarter standing stance as she presses one labeled alpine seed capsule into an open cryogenic storage rack with her right gloved hand while her left hand steadies a handheld inventory scanner aimed at that same capsule. Surround her with cold glass walls, condensation, glowing blue-green moss cultures, labeled seed drawers, amber task lamps, and distant snowy peaks. Prioritize unmistakable lean linear body proportions, clearly visible limb contours through practical clothing, and readable hand-to-capsule professional interaction. Use realistic skin, fabric, glass, and frost texture with documentary photographic detail.
